jangpm.label: Jangpm Lecture Deck
jangpm.summary: Korean-first lecture/report deck with monochrome + single #4633E3 indigo accent. Pretendard typography, 8px grid, Lucide line-art icons. Every content slide ends with a `.gm` governing message line.
jangpm.tone: Editorial, minimal, report-style, restrained. Notion/Linear/Vercel sensibility adapted to Korean instructional content.
jangpm.themeMode: Light only — warm off-white `#FAFAF9` background, `#1A1A1A` text, `#4633E3` single accent.

insightlearning.label: Insightlearning Company Deck
insightlearning.summary: 인싸이트러닝 HRD consulting deck: navy-first (#012281), square navy fields, sky (#58CCFF) only on navy narrative shells, filled light cards, top-left slide label + navy title rule + centered headline. Pretendard. Every content slide ends with a `.gm` line.
insightlearning.tone: Consultative, confident, polite declarative (~합니다), contrast-framed (A보다 B). Quiet, evidence-led company-profile register.
insightlearning.themeMode: Light content on #FFFFFF with #F8F8F8 filled cards; navy #012281 cover / chapter block / closing.
